### animate_dplyr
An R package (the "GIF library") that animates `dplyr` data transformations to make tidy-data operations visible to learners. Built with students Ryan and Sophia.

::: {.status}
In development · JOSS / JSDSE / R Journal targets
:::
:::

::: {.tag}
Shiny App

### Plots for Shots
An NBA "GOAT" dataset and Shiny app (Jordan, Kobe, LeBron) for teaching CRD-based introductory statistics.

::: {.status}
Manuscript in prep · Teaching Statistics
:::
